critical_coupling.method: direct minimization of 2 P[phi] / Q[phi] at fixed L2 mass

uv_control.delta_0: narrow normalized probes drive energy downward without bound numerically as width shrinks
uv_control.delta_0_1: same probes turn sharply positive as width shrinks
uv_control.interpretation: positive H2 rail arrests UV collapse

scientific_scope: This is a nondimensional numerical variational test. It supports existence of a localized negative-energy stationary candidate for the augmented functional at the tested parameters. It is not an empirical validation or a proof of continuum existence.

radial_second_variation.conclusion: All tested tangent Hessian spectra are strictly positive; the g=120 candidate is a strict local constrained minimum in the discretized radial sector.
radial_second_variation.limitation: This does not test nonspherical angular modes, complex phase perturbations, or the full time-dependent WCT evolution.
